svg.title: The version roadmap, a track over two rows
svg.desc: Seven versions on a track that snakes over two rows. v0.1, the four containers under Compose with CI, is done. v0.2, Prometheus and Grafana over the running stack, is next and is where the project stands. v0.3 moves the stack onto Kubernetes, v0.4 adds pull-based deployment with ArgoCD and a private production machine, v0.5 builds that machine from code with Terraform and Ansible, v1.0 lifts the design onto AWS, and v1.x swaps the cluster for EKS.
